evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Nicole skips directly into 'Let me go ahead and create a profile for you' without the time-boxed framing ('this will take 10-15 minutes, you can walk away with a quote you can depend on') or any wait for customer agreement.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Nicole moves straight into logistics probing: 'may I please have your email address' and then property details without ever asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns raised by customer at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised, so no reflection opportunity.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (house), stories (one story), bedrooms (3), driveway access (yes), shed/garage (yes), heavy items (none), appliances (TV only, customer handling), valuables (none), box count (50-60 range), additional stops (none) — all seven major items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'If you need us to to pack we can definitely help you with that.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'for a typical 1500 square footage home we usually expect to see around fifty to sixty boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full — typical range given ('usually takes around six to eight hours') and personalized to one-story-to-one-story with 7-minute drive: 'I estimate your move to be just within the minimum range six to seven hours' with budget of '$1,260 to $1,470.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full — trip/transport fees explicitly denied ('no hidden fees of any type, no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no ster fees, no disassemble or reassembly fees'), 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments disclosed: 'minimum of two and a half hours... prorated in fifteen minute increments... $52.50' per 15 minutes.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked — Nicole never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any equivalent. She moves directly into Two Promises section after the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full — 'if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange. We immediately start discounting money of your final bill' with discount clock explanation ('the time start as soon as we get on site and open the contract').
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full — 'no worries damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' (no deductible or fine print mentioned, and framed as included perk).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — Nicole does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm the two promises have answered the customer's concerns. Conversation moves into confirmation/booking without this check.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway — 'do you have any questions or anything for me before I let you go?' is the empty generic close, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: N/A — Customer does not raise any new concern at the final check; the only question is about on-time guarantee discount timing, which is immediately answered.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False — Nicole never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never — Nicole never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any direct close. She moves into 'I can definitely put you on the schedule' (an action statement, not an ask) after the customer says 'can you go ahead and get it confirmed and send me everything.' No explicit ask precedes the customer's soft offer to book.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True — 'no deposit record if you have to reschedule or cancel, no fees for that either the only time we take payment is once the moving process is done.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — Date confirmed (October 16th, 8:30 AM arrival window), phone number already captured, addresses confirmed (both addresses read back), crew size confirmed (2 movers and 1 truck). However, no notes left for the crew about customer concerns (customer had none raised, so nothing to note), and no explicit confirmation of arrival window 8:30–9:00 AM until the very end in the summary ('around 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM'). Confirmation email sent with one typo in the email address that had to be corrected. Missing: explicit crew notes about concerns, though no concerns were expressed.

top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, stories, rooms, access, special items, box count) with precision and confirmed the estimate with clear pricing transparency on hourly rate, minimum, increments, and no hidden fees.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business — skipped the explicit 'Would you like our help?' and let the customer pull the booking forward; also missed the quid pro quo framing at the open and 'does that feel fair?' after pricing, both load-bearing confidence-builders.
